bookInfo.author: Xue Juzheng et al.

title.zh: 卷一百〇二 漢書4: 隱帝本紀中
title.en: Volume 102 Book of Later Jin 4: Emperor Yin Annals 2
title.raw: 卷一百〇二 漢書4: 隱帝本紀中 Volume 102 Book of Later Jin 4: Emperor Yin Annals 2

sentences.zh: 乾祐二年春正月乙巳朔，制曰：

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the second year of Qianyou, on the day yisi at the new moon, an edict proclaimed:
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Qianyou 2, on the first day of the first month (yisi, new moon), an edict declared:

sentences.zh: 朕以渺躬，獲纘洪緒，念守器承祧之重，懷臨深履薄之憂。

translations.literal: I, with my slight person, have attained the great succession, mindful of the weight of guarding the vessel and inheriting the ancestral temple, bearing the anxiety of standing on the brink and treading on thin ice.
translations.idiomatic: I, though slight in person, have come into the great succession, mindful of the weight of guarding the vessel of state and inheriting the ancestral line, and filled with the anxiety of one standing on the brink and treading on thin ice.

sentences.zh: 屬以天道猶艱，王室多故，天降重戾，國有大喪，奸臣樂禍以圖危，群寇幸災而伺隙，力役未息，兵革方殷。

translations.literal: Moreover, as Heaven's Way remains arduous and the royal house has many troubles, Heaven has sent down heavy calamities and the state has great mourning; treacherous ministers rejoice in disaster to plot peril, bandits in groups count on calamity to watch for openings; corvée labor has not ceased and arms are flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Heaven's Way remains arduous and the royal house beset by troubles; Heaven has sent down heavy calamities and the state has suffered great mourning. Treacherous ministers rejoice in disaster to plot peril, while bandits in groups count on calamity to watch for openings. Corvée labor has not ceased, and war is raging.

sentences.zh: 朕所以嘗膽履冰，廢飧輟寐，雖居億兆之上，不以九五為尊，漸冀承平，永安遐邇。

translations.literal: Therefore I taste gall and tread on ice, abandon meals and cease sleep; though I dwell above the hundred million, I do not take the Nine-Five as honor, gradually hoping for lasting peace and eternal security near and far.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore I taste gall and tread on ice, forgoing meals and sleep. Though I sit above the myriad people, I do not take my exalted rank as a privilege, but gradually hope for lasting peace and security for all, near and far.

sentences.zh: 內則稟太后之慈訓，外則仗多士之忠勛，股肱葉謀，爪牙宣力。

translations.literal: Within I receive the Empress Dowager's kindly instruction; without I rely on many officers' loyal merit; arms and legs join in counsel, claws and teeth display their strength.
translations.idiomatic: Within, I heed the Empress Dowager's kindly instruction; without, I rely on the loyal merit of many officers. My chief ministers join in counsel, and my commanders exert their strength.

sentences.zh: 西摧三叛，撫其背而扼其喉；

translations.literal: In the west we crushed the three rebels, stroking their backs and seizing their throats;
translations.idiomatic: In the west we crushed the three rebels, pressing their backs and seizing their throats;

sentences.zh: 北挫諸蕃，斷其臂而折其脊。

translations.literal: In the north we blunted the various barbarians, cutting off their arms and breaking their spines.
translations.idiomatic: In the north we blunted the various frontier peoples, cutting off their arms and breaking their spines.

sentences.zh: 次則巴、邛嘯聚，淮、海猖狂，才聞矢接鋒交，已見山摧岸沮，寇難少息，師徒無虧。

translations.literal: Next, Ba and Qiong gathered with war cries, Huai and Hai ran wild; scarcely had arrows met blades when mountains were crushed and banks broken; bandit troubles slightly eased and the army suffered no loss.
translations.idiomatic: Next, rebels in Ba and Qiong rallied, while foes on the Huai and along the coast grew bold. Hardly had arrows met at the front when their forces were shattered like mountains and banks swept away. The bandit threat eased somewhat, and our army suffered no loss.

sentences.zh: 兼以修奉園陵，崇建宗廟，右賢左戚，同寅協恭，多事之中，大禮無闕，負荷斯重，哀感良深。

translations.literal: Moreover we have maintained the imperial tombs, exalted and built the ancestral temple, honored the worthy on the right and kin on the left, colleagues in harmony; amid many affairs great rites have not lapsed—the burden is so heavy and grief so deep.
translations.idiomatic: We have also tended the imperial tombs, raised and restored the ancestral temple, honored the worthy and cherished our kin, and kept colleagues in harmony. Amid so many affairs, the great rites have not lapsed. The burden I bear is heavy, and my grief runs deep.

sentences.zh: 今以三陽布和，四序更始，宜申兌澤，允答天休，恤獄緩刑，舍過宥罪，當萬物之莩甲，開三面之網羅，順彼發生，以召和氣。

translations.literal: Now, as the three yangs spread harmony and the four seasons begin anew, we should extend the joy of Dui, truly answer Heaven's favor, show mercy in prisons and ease punishments, pardon faults and forgive crimes; as the myriad things break their shells, open the net on three sides, follow their sprouting to summon harmonious qi.
translations.idiomatic: Now, as the three yangs spread harmony and the four seasons turn anew, we should extend gracious favor and answer Heaven's blessing: show mercy in the prisons, ease punishments, pardon faults, and forgive crimes. As the myriad things break from their shells, we open the net on three sides, following their growth to summon harmonious qi.

sentences.zh: 應乾祐二年正月一日昧爽已前，天下見禁罪人，除十惡五逆、官典犯贓、合造毒藥、劫家殺人正身外，其餘並放。

translations.literal: For all prisoners under detention throughout the realm before dawn on the first day of the first month of Qianyou year 2, except the ten abominations, five rebellions, officials who embezzle, those who compound poison, and principal offenders in robbery and murder, the rest are all to be released.
translations.idiomatic: All prisoners held throughout the realm before dawn on the first day of the first month of Qianyou 2 are to be released, except those guilty of the ten abominations, the five rebellions, official embezzlement, compounding poison, or robbery and murder as principal offenders.

sentences.zh: 河府李守貞、鳳翔王景崇、永興趙思綰等，比與國家素無讎釁，偶因疑懼，遂至叛違。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen of Hedong, Wang Jingchong of Fengxiang, Zhao Sihuan of Yongxing, and the like have lately had no old enmity with the state but, by chance through suspicion and fear, came to rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen of Hedong, Wang Jingchong of Fengxiang, Zhao Sihuan of Yongxing, and the like have had no old feud with the state but, seized by suspicion and fear, turned to rebellion.

sentences.zh: 然以彼之生靈，朕之赤子，久陷孤壘，可念非辜，易子析骸，填溝委壑，為人父母，寧不軫傷！

translations.literal: Yet those living people are my red infants; long trapped in isolated forts, pitiable and innocent, exchanging children and splitting bones, filling ditches and casting into ravines—as a father and mother, how could I not be deeply grieved!
translations.idiomatic: Yet those people are my own children. Long trapped in isolated forts, innocent victims suffering such hardship that they exchange children and split bones to survive, filling ditches and ravines with the dead—as their sovereign parent, how could I not grieve deeply!

sentences.zh: 但以屈己愛人，先王厚德，包垢含辱，列聖美談，宜推濟物之恩，用廣好生之道。

translations.literal: But in humbling oneself to love others, the former kings' thick virtue, wrapping filth and bearing insult—the successive sages' fine words—we should extend the grace of succoring things and broadly apply the Way of cherishing life.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the former kings humbled themselves to love others, bearing thick virtue, wrapping filth and enduring insult—a fine tradition of our sages. We should extend grace to succor all beings and broadly apply the Way of cherishing life.

sentences.zh: 其李守貞等，宜令逐處都部署分明曉諭，若能翻然歸順，朕即待之如初，當保始終，享其富貴，明申信誓，固無改移。

translations.literal: As for Li Shouzhen and the like, each regional commander-in-chief should clearly announce: if they can suddenly turn and submit, I will treat them as at first, secure them from beginning to end, let them enjoy wealth and honor, clearly declare sworn faith, and firmly not change.
translations.idiomatic: As for Li Shouzhen and the like, each regional commander-in-chief should clearly proclaim: if they turn and submit, I will treat them as before, secure their fortunes from beginning to end, and let them enjoy wealth and honor. Our sworn faith is declared plainly and will not change.

sentences.zh: 其或不順推誠，堅欲拒命，便可應時攻擊，克日蕩平。

translations.literal: If they do not follow and offer sincerity but stubbornly wish to refuse orders, then at once attack in season and on the set day sweep them flat.
translations.idiomatic: If they refuse sincerity and stubbornly resist our orders, attack them at once and sweep them away on the appointed day.

sentences.zh: 候收復城池，罪止元惡，其餘詿誤，一切不問。

translations.literal: When the cities are recovered, guilt stops at the chief villains; the rest who were misled—all will not be questioned.
translations.idiomatic: When the cities are recovered, guilt will rest only on the chief villains; all others who were misled will not be questioned.

sentences.zh: 重念征討已來，勞役滋甚，兵猶在野，民未息肩，急賦繁征，財殫力匱。

translations.literal: We again recall that since the campaigns began, corvée has grown severe, troops still in the field, the people not resting their shoulders, urgent levies and frequent collections, wealth exhausted and strength depleted.
translations.idiomatic: We again recall that since the campaigns began, corvée has grown severe, troops remain in the field, and the people have not rested their shoulders. Urgent levies and frequent collections have exhausted wealth and depleted strength.

sentences.zh: 矜恤之澤，未被於疲羸；

translations.literal: The grace of compassionate care has not reached the weary and weak;
translations.idiomatic: The grace of compassionate care has not yet reached the weary and weak;

sentences.zh: 愁嘆之聲，幾盈於道路。

translations.literal: the sounds of grief and sighing nearly fill the roads.
translations.idiomatic: and sounds of grief and sighing nearly fill the roads.

sentences.zh: 即俟邊鋒少弭，國患漸除，當議優饒，冀獲蘇息。

translations.literal: We shall wait until the frontier blades slightly subside and state troubles gradually clear, then deliberate generous relief, hoping for recovery and rest.
translations.idiomatic: We shall wait until the frontier fighting subsides and state troubles gradually clear, then deliberate generous relief in hope of recovery and rest.

sentences.zh: 諸道藩侯郡守等，鹹分寄任，共體憂勞，更宜念彼瘡痍，倍加勤恤，究鄉閭之疾苦，去州縣之煩苛，勸課耕桑，省察冤濫，共恢庶政，用副憂勞。

translations.literal: Regional lords, prefects, and the like all share entrusted duties and together bear worry and toil; they should further mind those wounds, doubly apply diligent care, investigate village and hamlet suffering, remove prefectural and county vexations, encourage farming and sericulture, examine wrongful and excessive cases, together restore common government, to match our worry and toil.
translations.idiomatic: Regional lords, prefects, and the like all share entrusted duties and our common burden. They should further heed the wounds of the land, redouble diligent care, investigate suffering in villages and hamlets, remove vexatious prefectural and county exactions, encourage farming and sericulture, examine wrongful and excessive cases, and together restore good government to match our shared burden.

sentences.zh: 凡百臣僚，當體朕意。

translations.literal: All the hundred officials should embody my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Let all officials take my intent to heart.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賜前昭義軍節度使張從恩衣一襲，金帶、鞍馬、彩帛等。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, bestowed on former Zhaoyi Army military commissioner Zhang Cong'en one suit of robes, a gold belt, saddle horse, colored silks, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the court bestowed on former Zhaoyi military commissioner Zhang Cong'en a suit of robes, a gold belt, a saddle horse, colored silks, and the like.

sentences.zh: 時有投無名文字誣告從恩者，故特有是賜，以安其心。

translations.literal: At the time someone had submitted an anonymous letter falsely accusing Cong'en; therefore this special gift was made to settle his mind.
translations.idiomatic: At the time someone had submitted an anonymous letter falsely accusing Cong'en, so the court made this special gift to reassure him.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，河府軍前奏，今月四日夜，賊軍偷斫河西寨，捕斬七百餘級。

translations.literal: On yimao, the Hedong army front reported: on the night of the fourth of this month, rebel troops secretly cut the Hexi stockade; over seven hundred were captured and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Hedong army front reported that on the night of the fourth of this month rebel troops had secretly attacked the Hexi stockade and that more than seven hundred were captured and beheaded.

sentences.zh: 時蜀軍自大散關來援王景崇，郭威自將兵赴岐下，將行，戒白文珂、劉詞等曰：「賊之驍勇，並在城西，慎為儆備。

translations.literal: At the time Shu troops came from Dasan Pass to aid Wang Jingchong; Guo Wei personally led troops to Qixia; about to depart, he warned Bai Wenke, Liu Ci, and the like, saying: "The rebels' fiercest warriors are all west of the city—take careful precautions."
translations.idiomatic: At the time Shu troops came from Dasan Pass to aid Wang Jingchong. Guo Wei personally led troops toward Qizhou. Before departing, he warned Bai Wenke, Liu Ci, and the others: "The rebels' fiercest warriors are all west of the city. Take careful precautions."

sentences.zh: 」既行，至華州，聞川軍退敗，且憂文珂等為賊奔突，遂兼程而回。

translations.literal: " After he had gone, reaching Hua Prefecture he heard the Shu army had retreated in defeat, and also feared Wenke and the rest might be rushed by rebels, so he hurried back by forced marches.
translations.idiomatic: " After he had gone, on reaching Hua Prefecture he heard the Shu army had retreated in defeat and feared that Wenke and the others might be overrun by rebels, so he hurried back by forced marches.

sentences.zh: 賊城內偵知郭威西行，於正月四日夜，遣賊將王三鐵等，

translations.literal: Spies in the rebel city learned Guo Wei had gone west; on the night of the fourth of the first month they sent the rebel general Wang Santie and the like,
translations.idiomatic: Spies in the rebel city learned that Guo Wei had gone west. On the night of the fourth of the first month they sent the rebel general Wang Santie and others

sentences.zh: （《宋史·王繼勛傳》：繼勛有武勇，在軍陣常用鐵鞭、鐵槊、鐵楇，軍中目為「王三鐵」。）〉

translations.literal: (Song History, Biography of Wang Jiji: Jiji was brave in battle and in the ranks commonly used an iron whip, iron spear, and iron mace; the army called him "Wang Santie.") )
translations.idiomatic: (Song History, Biography of Wang Jiji: Jiji was brave in battle and in the ranks commonly used an iron whip, iron spear, and iron mace; the army called him "Wang Three-Irons.") )

sentences.zh: 率驍勇千餘人，沿流南行，坎岸而登，為三道來攻。

translations.literal: leading over a thousand fierce warriors, going south along the stream, climbing the bank, and attacking in three columns.
translations.idiomatic: leading more than a thousand fierce warriors south along the stream, climbing the bank, and attacking in three columns.

sentences.zh: 賊軍已入王師寨中，劉詞極力拒之，短兵既接，遂敗之。

translations.literal: The rebel army had already entered the imperial army's stockade; Liu Ci resisted with all his strength; once close combat joined, he defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel army had already entered the imperial stockade, but Liu Ci resisted with all his strength. Once close combat was joined, he defeated them.

sentences.zh: 二月丙子，詔：「諸道州府，所征乾祐元年夏秋苗畝上紐征白米稈草已納外，並放。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day bingzi, an edict: "In all circuits' prefectures and districts, levies for Qianyou year 1 summer-autumn field tax, upper-grade white rice, and straw already paid are all remitted."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on bingzi, an edict declared: "In all circuits' prefectures and districts, levies for Qianyou 1 summer-autumn field tax, upper-grade white rice, and straw already paid are all remitted."

sentences.zh: 」是日旦，黑霧四塞。

translations.literal: " At dawn that day, black fog blocked all four sides.
translations.idiomatic: " At dawn that day, black fog blocked the land on every side.

sentences.zh: 丁丑夕，大風。

translations.literal: On the evening of dingchou, a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: On the evening of dingchou, a great wind blew.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以前房州刺史李筠夫為鴻臚卿。

translations.literal: On yiyou, former Fang Prefecture inspector Li Junfu was made Director of the Court for Diplomatic Relations.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, former Fang prefect Li Junfu was appointed Director of the Court for Diplomatic Relations.

sentences.zh: 戊子，前右監門將軍喬達，及其兄契丹偽命客省使榮等皆棄市。

translations.literal: On wuzi, former Right Gate Guard General Qiao Da and his elder brother Rong, whom the Khitan had falsely appointed Reception Commissioner, and the like were all executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, former Right Gate Guard General Qiao Da, his elder brother Rong (whom the Khitan had falsely appointed Reception Commissioner), and the like were all executed in the market.

sentences.zh: 達，李守貞之妹婿也，故皆誅之。

translations.literal: Da was Li Shouzhen's sister's husband; therefore all were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Da was Li Shouzhen's brother-in-law, and therefore all were put to death.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，徐州巡檢使成德欽奏，至峒吾鎮遇淮賊，破之，殺五百人，生擒一百二十人。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Xuzhou patrol commissioner Cheng Deqin memorialized: reaching Dongwu Town he met Huai rebels, defeated them, killed five hundred, and captured alive one hundred twenty.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Xuzhou patrol commissioner Cheng Deqin reported that at Dongwu Town he met Huai rebels, defeated them, killed five hundred, and captured one hundred twenty alive.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大雨霖。

translations.literal: On wuxu, great prolonged rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, heavy prolonged rain fell.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔左諫議大夫賈緯等修撰高祖實錄。

translations.literal: On gengzi, ordered Left Remonstrance Grandee Jia Wei and the like to compile the Veritable Records of Gaozu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the court ordered Left Remonstrance Grandee Jia Wei and others to compile the Veritable Records of Gaozu.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，以北京衙內指揮使劉鈞為汾州防禦使。

translations.literal: In the third month on bingchen, made Northern Capital inner-palace commander Liu Jun Fenzhou defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on bingchen, Northern Capital inner-palace commander Liu Jun was appointed defense commissioner of Fen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子，以荊南節度行軍司馬、武泰軍節度留後王保義為檢校太尉，領武泰軍節度使，行軍如故。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month on bingzi, made Jingnan military commissioner's campaign army marshal and Wutai Army acting military commissioner Wang Baoyi Acting Grand Preceptor, holding Wutai military commissioner, campaign duties as before.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month on bingzi, Jingnan campaign army marshal and acting Wutai military commissioner Wang Baoyi was made Acting Grand Preceptor and confirmed as Wutai military commissioner, with his campaign duties unchanged.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，潁州獻紫兔、白兔。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Ying Prefecture presented a purple rabbit and a white rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Ying Prefecture presented a purple rabbit and a white rabbit.

sentences.zh: 是月，幽、定、滄、貝、深、冀等州地震。

translations.literal: That month, You, Ding, Cang, Bei, Shen, Ji, and other prefectures had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: That month, You, Ding, Cang, Bei, Shen, Ji, and other prefectures were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太白經天。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Taibai crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Venus crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，幸道宮禱雨。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the emperor visited a Daoist temple to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the emperor visited a Daoist temple to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰朔，故湖南節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令、扶風郡公、贈太師馬希聲追封衡陽王。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the new moon day jiachen, the late Hunan military commissioner, Acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, Fufeng Duke, posthumously Grand Preceptor Ma Xisheng was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on the new moon (jiachen), the late Hunan military commissioner Ma Xisheng, formerly Acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, Fufeng Duke, and posthumously Grand Preceptor, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以前邠州節度使安審約為左神武統軍，以前洛京副留守袁鳷為右神武統軍。

translations.literal: On wushen, former Bin Prefecture military commissioner An Shengyue was made Left Divine Martial commander; former Luoyang deputy defender Yuan Zhi was made Right Divine Martial commander.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, former Bin military commissioner An Shengyue was appointed Left Divine Martial commander, and former Luoyang deputy defender Yuan Zhi was appointed Right Divine Martial commander.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，河府軍前奏，今月九日，河中節度副使周光遜棄賊河西寨，與將士一千一百三十人來奔。

translations.literal: On yimao, the Hedong army front reported: on the ninth of this month, Hedong deputy military commissioner Zhou Guangxun abandoned the rebels' Hexi stockade and came over with one thousand one hundred thirty officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Hedong army front reported that on the ninth of this month Hedong deputy military commissioner Zhou Guangxun had abandoned the rebels' Hexi stockade and defected with one thousand one hundred thirty officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 己未，右監門大將軍許遷上言，奉使至博州博平縣界，睹蝝生彌亙數里，一夕並化為蝶飛去。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Right Gate Guard Grand General Xu Qian submitted: on mission reaching the border of Boping County, Bo Prefecture, he saw young locusts spread for several li; in one night they all turned into butterflies and flew away.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Right Gate Guard Grand General Xu Qian reported that on a mission to the border of Boping County in Bo Prefecture he had seen young locusts spread for several li, and that in one night they had all turned into butterflies and flown away.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，兗、鄆、齊三州奏蝝生。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Yan, Yun, and Qi prefectures reported young locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Yan, Yun, and Qi prefectures reported young locusts.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，永興趙思綰遣牙將劉成詣闕乞降，制授趙思綰華州節度留後、檢校太保，以永興城內都指揮使常彥卿為虢州刺史。

translations.literal: On yichou, Yongxing's Zhao Sihuan sent military adjutant Liu Cheng to the court to beg surrender; by edict Zhao Sihuan was made Hua Prefecture acting military commissioner and Acting Grand Guardian; Yongxing inner-city commander Chang Yanqing was made Guo Prefecture inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Zhao Sihuan of Yongxing sent military adjutant Liu Cheng to court to surrender. By edict Zhao Sihuan was appointed acting Hua military commissioner and Acting Grand Guardian, and Yongxing inner-city commander Chang Yanqing was made inspector of Guo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，宋州奏，蝗抱草而死。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Song Prefecture reported locusts clutching grass and dying.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Song Prefecture reported that locusts were clutching grass and dying.

sentences.zh: 己巳，湖南奏，蠻寇賀州，遣大將軍徐進率兵援之，戰於風陽山下，大敗蠻獠，斬首五千級。

translations.literal: On jisi, Hunan reported: barbarians raided He Prefecture; Grand General Xu Jin was sent leading troops to aid; they fought below Fengyang Mountain, greatly defeated the Man and Liao, beheading five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Hunan reported that barbarians had raided He Prefecture. Grand General Xu Jin was sent with troops to aid the defense. At Fengyang Mountain they inflicted a great defeat on the Man and Liao, beheading five thousand.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the new moon day guiyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on the new moon (guiyou), there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 兗州奏，捕蝗二萬斛，魏、博、宿三州蝗抱草而死。

translations.literal: Yan Prefecture reported capturing twenty thousand hu of locusts; Wei, Bo, and Su prefectures reported locusts clutching grass and dying.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Prefecture reported capturing twenty thousand hu of locusts. Wei, Bo, and Su prefectures reported locusts clutching grass and dying.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，潁州獻白鹿。

translations.literal: On yihai, Ying Prefecture presented a white deer.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Ying Prefecture presented a white deer.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，安州節度使楊信奏，亡父光遠，蒙賜神道碑，鐫勒畢，無故中斷。

translations.literal: On wuyin, An Prefecture military commissioner Yang Xin memorialized: his late father Guangyuan had received the gift of a spirit-way stele; when carving was finished it broke in the middle for no reason.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, An military commissioner Yang Xin reported that the spirit-way stele granted for his late father Guangyuan had broken in the middle for no reason after the inscription was finished.

sentences.zh: 詔別令斷石鐫勒。

translations.literal: An edict ordered a separate stone cut and carved.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered a new stone cut and inscribed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，滑、濮、澶、漕、兗、淄、青、齊、宿、懷、相、衛、博、陳等州奏蝗，分命中使致祭於所在川澤山林之神。

translations.literal: On jimao, Hua, Pu, Chan, Cao, Yan, Zi, Qing, Qi, Su, Huai, Xiang, Wei, Bo, Chen, and other prefectures reported locusts; eunuch envoys were separately ordered to offer sacrifice to the gods of rivers, marshes, mountains, and forests in each place.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Hua, Pu, Chan, Cao, Yan, Zi, Qing, Qi, Su, Huai, Xiang, Wei, Bo, Chen, and other prefectures reported locusts. Eunuch envoys were dispatched to offer sacrifice to the gods of rivers, marshes, mountains, and forests in each locality.

sentences.zh: 開封府、滑、曹等州蝗甚，遣使捕之。

translations.literal: Kaifeng Prefecture, Hua, Cao, and other prefectures had severe locusts; envoys were sent to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng Prefecture, Hua, Cao, and other prefectures suffered severe locust infestations, and envoys were sent to capture them.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·段思恭傳》：隱帝蝗詔遍祈山川。

translations.literal: (Song History, Biography of Duan Sigong: Emperor Yin's locust edict ordered prayers throughout mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: (Song History, Biography of Duan Sigong: When Emperor Yin's locust edict ordered prayers throughout mountains and rivers,

sentences.zh: 思恭上言：「赦過宥罪，議獄緩刑，茍獄訟平允，則災害不生。

translations.literal: Sigong submitted: "Pardoning faults and forgiving crimes, deliberating prisons and easing punishments—if prison cases are fair, then disasters will not arise.
translations.idiomatic: Sigong submitted: "Pardoning faults and forgiving crimes, deliberating prisons and easing punishments—if prison cases are judged fairly, disasters will not arise.

sentences.zh: 望令諸州速決重刑，無致淹濫，必召和平。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will order all prefectures to decide heavy punishments quickly and not allow delay and excess—this will surely summon peace."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that all prefectures be ordered to decide heavy cases quickly and not allow delay and abuse—this will surely bring peace."

translations.literal: The edict was followed.) )
translations.idiomatic: The court followed his advice.) )

sentences.zh: 壬午，月犯心星。

translations.literal: On renwu, the moon transgressed the Heart star.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the moon transgressed the Heart constellation.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，回鶻遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the Uyghurs sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Uyghurs sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 丙申，改商州乾元縣為乾祐縣，隸京兆府。

translations.literal: On bingshen, changed Shang Prefecture's Qianyuan County to Qianyou County, subordinate to Jingzhao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Shang Prefecture's Qianyuan County was renamed Qianyou County and placed under Jingzhao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是月，邠、寧、澤、潞、涇、延、鄜、坊、晉、絳等州旱。

translations.literal: That month, Bin, Ning, Ze, Lu, Jing, Yan, Fu, Fang, Jin, Jiang, and other prefectures had drought.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Bin, Ning, Ze, Lu, Jing, Yan, Fu, Fang, Jin, Jiang, and other prefectures suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，湖南奏，析長沙縣東界為龍喜縣。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month on xinhai, Hunan memorialized: the eastern border of Changsha County was split off as Longxi County.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month on xinhai, Hunan reported that the eastern border of Changsha County had been split off to form Longxi County.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，樞密使郭威奏，收復河府羅城，李守貞退保子城。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei memorialized: recovered Hedong's outer wall; Li Shouzhen withdrew to hold the inner citadel.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei reported that Hedong's outer wall had been recovered and Li Shouzhen had withdrawn to hold the inner citadel.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，永興都部署郭從義奏：「新除華州留後趙思綰，自今月三日授華州留後，準詔赴任，三移行期，仍要鎧甲以給牙兵，及與之，竟不遵路。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Yongxing commander-in-chief Guo Congyi memorialized: "The newly appointed Hua acting military commissioner Zhao Sihuan, since receiving Hua acting commissioner on the third of this month and ordered by edict to take office, thrice shifted his departure date, still demanded armor to supply his guard troops, and once given it still would not take the road."
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Yongxing commander-in-chief Guo Congyi reported: "The newly appointed acting Hua military commissioner Zhao Sihuan, since his appointment on the third of this month and the edict ordering him to take office, has thrice postponed his departure, demanded armor for his guard troops, and even after receiving it still refuses to take the road."

sentences.zh: 至九日夕，有部曲曹彥進告，思綰欲於十一日夜與同惡五百人奔南山入蜀。

translations.literal: By the evening of the ninth, a subordinate Cao Yanjin reported that Sihuan intended on the night of the eleventh to flee south into the mountains into Shu with five hundred fellow villains.
translations.idiomatic: By the evening of the ninth, a subordinate named Cao Yanjin reported that Sihuan intended on the night of the eleventh to flee south into the mountains into Shu with five hundred fellow conspirators.

sentences.zh: 是日詰旦，再促上路，雲俟夜進途。

translations.literal: At dawn that day he was again urged to take the road; he said he would wait for night to advance.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn that day he was again urged to depart, but he said he would wait until night to set out.

sentences.zh: 臣尋與王峻入城，分兵守四門，其趙思綰部下軍，各已執帶，遂至牙署，令趙思綰至則執之，與一行徒黨，並處置訖。

translations.literal: Your servant then entered the city with Wang Jun, divided troops to guard the four gates; Zhao Sihuan's subordinate troops had all already buckled on their belts; we then reached the headquarters, ordered that when Zhao Sihuan arrived he be seized, and together with his whole band of followers all were dealt with.
translations.idiomatic: I then entered the city with Wang Jun and divided troops to guard the four gates. Zhao Sihuan's troops had already armed themselves. We reached headquarters, seized Zhao Sihuan when he arrived, and dealt with him and his entire band of followers."

sentences.zh: 」甲子，樞密使郭威奏，收復河中府，逆賊李守貞自燔而死。

translations.literal: " On jiazi, Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei memorialized: recovered Hedong Prefecture; the rebel Li Shouzhen burned himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiazi, Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei reported that Hedong Prefecture had been recovered and the rebel Li Shouzhen had burned himself to death.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以權涼州留後折逋嘉施為河西軍節度留後。

translations.literal: On bingyin, acting Liang Prefecture commissioner Zhebo Jiashi was made Hexi Army acting military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, acting Liang commissioner Zhebo Jiashi was appointed acting Hexi military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 兗州奏，捕蝗二萬斛。

translations.literal: Yan Prefecture reported capturing twenty thousand hu of locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Prefecture reported capturing twenty thousand hu of locusts.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，前洺州團練使武漢球卒。

translations.literal: On dingmao, former Ming Prefecture militia commissioner Wu Hanqiu died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, former Ming militia commissioner Wu Hanqiu died.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，永興軍節度使兼兵馬都部署郭從義加同平章事，徙華州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Yongxing Army military commissioner and concurrent army commander-in-chief Guo Congyi was made concurrent Councilor of State and transferred to Hua military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Yongxing military commissioner and army commander-in-chief Guo Congyi was made concurrent Councilor of State and transferred to Hua military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 郭從義奏，處斬前巡檢使喬守溫，供奉官王益、時知化、任繼勛等。

translations.literal: Guo Congyi memorialized: executed former patrol commissioner Qiao Shouwen, Palace Supply Officer Wang Yi, Shi Zhihua, Ren Jixun, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Congyi reported that former patrol commissioner Qiao Shouwen, Palace Supply Officer Wang Yi, Shi Zhihua, Ren Jixun, and others had been executed.

sentences.zh: 守溫受高祖命巡檢京兆，會王益自鳳翔押送趙思綰等赴闕，行至京兆，守溫迎益於郊外，思綰等突然作亂，遂據其城。

translations.literal: Shouwen had received Gaozu's order to patrol Jingzhao; it happened that Wang Yi was escorting Zhao Sihuan and the like from Fengxiang to the court; reaching Jingzhao, Shouwen welcomed Yi in the suburbs; Sihuan and the rest suddenly rebelled and seized the city.
translations.idiomatic: Shouwen had been ordered by Gaozu to patrol Jingzhao. When Wang Yi was escorting Zhao Sihuan and the others from Fengxiang to court, Shouwen welcomed him in the suburbs at Jingzhao. Sihuan and his party suddenly rebelled and seized the city.

sentences.zh: 及郭從義率兵攻討，令守溫部署役夫。

translations.literal: When Guo Congyi led troops to attack, he ordered Shouwen to arrange corvée laborers.
translations.idiomatic: When Guo Congyi led troops to attack, he ordered Shouwen to arrange corvée laborers.

sentences.zh: 守溫有愛姬陷在賊城，為思綰所錄，及收城，從義盡得思綰之婢仆，守溫求其愛姬，從義雖與之，意有所慊，遂發前罪，密啟於郭威，請除之，與王益等並誅焉。

translations.literal: Shouwen had a beloved concubine trapped in the rebel city, taken by Sihuan; when the city was recovered, Congyi obtained all Sihuan's maids and servants; Shouwen asked for his beloved concubine; though Congyi gave her to him, he felt somewhat unsatisfied, then exposed Shouwen's former crimes, secretly reported to Guo Wei requesting his removal, and he was executed together with Wang Yi and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Shouwen's beloved concubine had been trapped in the rebel city and taken by Sihuan. When the city was recovered, Congyi obtained all of Sihuan's maids and servants. Shouwen asked for his concubine back. Though Congyi returned her, he remained dissatisfied, exposed Shouwen's former crimes, secretly reported to Guo Wei requesting his removal, and Shouwen was executed together with Wang Yi and the others.

sentences.zh: 兗州奏，捕蝗四萬斛。

translations.literal: Yan Prefecture reported capturing forty thousand hu of locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Prefecture reported capturing forty thousand hu of locusts.

sentences.zh: 壬午，西京留臺侍御史趙礪彈奏，太子太保王延、太子洗馬張季凝等，自去年五月後來，每稱請假，俱是不任拜起。

translations.literal: On renwu, Western Capital Retired Emperor's Terrace attendant censor Zhao Li impeached: Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent Wang Yan, Heir Apparent Stud Zhang Jining, and the like, since the fifth month of last year, each time claiming leave—all were unable to perform bowing and rising.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Western Capital attendant censor Zhao Li impeached Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent Wang Yan, Heir Apparent Stud Zhang Jining, and others for repeatedly claiming leave since the fifth month of last year, all being unable to perform bowing and rising.

sentences.zh: 詔延等宜以本官致仕。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yan and the like to retire with their present offices.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yan and the others to retire with their present titles.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以陜州節度使、充河中一行兵馬都部署白文珂為西京留守，加兼侍中；

translations.literal: On jiashen, made Shan Prefecture military commissioner and concurrent Hedong campaign army commander-in-chief Bai Wenke Western Capital defender, additionally concurrent Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Shan military commissioner and concurrent Hedong campaign commander-in-chief Bai Wenke was made Western Capital defender and additionally Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 潞州節度使、充河中一行副都署常思加檢校太師；

translations.literal: Lu Prefecture military commissioner and concurrent Hedong campaign deputy commander Chang Si was made Acting Grand Preceptor;
translations.idiomatic: Lu military commissioner and concurrent Hedong campaign deputy commander Chang Si was made Acting Grand Preceptor;

sentences.zh: 以右散騎常侍盧撰為戶部侍郎致仕。

translations.literal: made Right Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Lu Zhuan Vice Minister of Revenue, retired.
translations.idiomatic: and Right Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Lu Zhuan was retired as Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，右拾遺高守瓊上言：「仕官年未三十，請不除授縣令。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Right Reminder Gao Shouqiong submitted: "Officials under thirty years of age—please do not appoint them as county magistrates."
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Right Reminder Gao Shouqiong submitted: "Officials under thirty years of age should not be appointed county magistrates."

sentences.zh: 」詔：「起今後諸色選人，年及七十者，宜註優散官；

translations.literal: " An edict: "From now on, for candidates of all categories, those reaching seventy should be registered for superior scattered offices;
translations.idiomatic: " An edict declared: "From now on, candidates of all categories who reach seventy should be registered for superior scattered offices;

sentences.zh: 年少未歷資考者，不得註擬縣令。

translations.literal: those young and not having passed qualification examinations may not be registered for county magistrate."
translations.idiomatic: and those young and without qualification examinations may not be registered for county magistrate."

sentences.zh: 」癸巳，以翰林學士、工部尚書張沆為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: " On guisi, made Hanlin Academician and Minister of Works Zhang Hong Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: " On guisi, Hanlin Academician and Minister of Works Zhang Hong was appointed Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 沆卜葬先人，以內署無例乞假，乃上章請解職，以赴葬事，遂落職以遣之。

translations.literal: Hong divined burial for his forebears; as the inner secretariat had no precedent for requesting leave, he submitted a memorial asking to resign his post to attend the burial, and was therefore removed from office and sent off.
translations.idiomatic: Hong had divined a burial site for his ancestors. As the inner secretariat had no precedent for leave, he submitted a memorial asking to resign to attend the burial and was removed from office and sent off.

sentences.zh: 乙未，宣徽南院使、永興行營兵馬都監王峻，宣徽北院使、河府行營兵馬都監吳虔裕，並加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat commissioner and Yongxing campaign army supervisor Wang Jun, and Northern Bureau commissioner and Hedong campaign army supervisor Wu Qianyu were both made Acting Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Southern Palace Secretariat commissioner and Yongxing campaign army supervisor Wang Jun, and Northern commissioner and Hedong campaign army supervisor Wu Qianyu were both made Acting Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 九月乙己，樞密使郭威檢校太師、兼侍中，宋州節度使兼侍衛親軍都指揮使史宏肇加兼中書令。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on yiji, Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei was made Acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Attendant; Song Prefecture military commissioner and concurrent Imperial Guard commander Shi Hongzhao was additionally made Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on yiji, Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei was made Acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Attendant, and Song military commissioner and Imperial Guard commander Shi Hongzhao was additionally made Secretariat Director.

sentences.zh: 初，郭威平河中回，朝廷議加恩，威奏曰：「臣出兵已來，輦轂之下，無犬吠之憂，俾臣得專一其事，軍旅所聚，資糧不乏，此皆居中大臣鎮撫謀畫之功也，臣安敢獨擅其美乎！

translations.literal: Earlier, when Guo Wei returned from pacifying Hedong, the court deliberated increasing favors; Wei memorialized: "Since your servant led troops forth, below the imperial carriage there has been no worry of dogs barking, enabling your servant to devote himself to this affair alone; where armies gathered, supplies were not lacking—all this is the achievement of the central great ministers in pacifying and planning; how dare your servant monopolize the credit!"
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Guo Wei returned from pacifying Hedong, the court deliberated on rewards. Wei memorialized: "Since I led troops forth, the capital has had no worry of disturbance, enabling me to devote myself wholly to the campaign. Where armies gathered, supplies were plentiful—all this is the achievement of the central ministers in pacifying and planning. How dare I claim the credit alone!"

sentences.zh: 」帝然之，於是宏肇與宰相、樞密使、三司使，次第加恩。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved; thereupon Hongzhao, the chief ministers, the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner, and the Three Departments commissioner received favors in turn.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved, and Hongzhao, the chief ministers, the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner, and the Three Departments commissioner were rewarded in turn.

sentences.zh: 既而諸大臣以恩之所被，皆朝廷親近之臣，而宗室劉信及青州劉銖等皆國家元勛，必有不平之意，且外慮諸侯以朝廷有私於親近也，於是議及四方侯伯，普加恩焉。

translations.literal: Then the great ministers, because the favors fell on all the court's intimate ministers, while imperial clansman Liu Xin and Qing Prefecture's Liu Zhu and the like were all the state's founding meritorious officials and would surely feel discontent—and also fearing outwardly that the regional lords would think the court showed partiality to intimates—thereupon deliberated extending to the four directions' marquises and earls, granting favors universally.
translations.idiomatic: Then the great ministers noted that the rewards had fallen only on the court's intimate ministers, while imperial clansman Liu Xin, Qing's Liu Zhu, and other founding meritorious officials would surely feel discontent. They also feared that regional lords would think the court favored its intimates. The court therefore extended rewards universally to marquises and earls throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丙午，西京留守判官時彥澄、推官姜蟾、少尹崔淑並免居官，坐不隨府罷職，為留臺侍御史趙礪所彈也。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Western Capital defender aide Shi Yancheng, investigating officer Jiang Chan, and junior prefecture director Cui Shu were all removed from office, sitting because they did not follow the prefecture in leaving office, impeached by Retired Emperor's Terrace attendant censor Zhao Li.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Western Capital defender aide Shi Yancheng, investigating officer Jiang Chan, and junior prefecture director Cui Shu were all removed from office for failing to leave office when the prefecture was abolished, as impeached by attendant censor Zhao Li.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以右千牛上將軍孫漢赟為絳州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiyou, made Right Thousand-Ox Upper General Sun Hanyun Jiang Prefecture inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Right Thousand-Ox Upper General Sun Hanyun was appointed inspector of Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書、判吏部尚書銓事王松停見任，坐子仁寶為李守貞從事也，尋卒於其第。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites and acting Minister of Personnel selection affairs Wang Song was suspended from present office, sitting because his son Renbao had been Li Shouzhen's staff member; soon after he died at his residence.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites and acting Minister of Personnel selection Wang Song was suspended from office because his son Renbao had served Li Shouzhen; he soon died at his residence.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，宰臣竇貞固加守司徒，蘇逢吉加守司空，蘇禹珪加左僕射，楊邠加右僕射，依前兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On xinhai, chief minister Dou Zhengu was made Acting Minister of Education; Su Fengji Acting Minister of Works; Su Yugui Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Yang Bin Right Vice Director, as before additionally Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, chief minister Dou Zhengu was made Acting Minister of Education, Su Fengji Acting Minister of Works, Su Yugui Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Yang Bin Right Vice Director while retaining his post as Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 太子太師致仕皇甫立卒。

translations.literal: Retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent Huangfu Li died.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent Huangfu Li died.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，三司使王章加邑封。

translations.literal: On guichou, Three Departments commissioner Wang Zhang received increased fief enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Three Departments commissioner Wang Zhang received an increased fief enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，鄴都高行周加守太師，襄州安審琦加守太傅，兗州府符彥卿加守太保，北京劉崇加兼中書令。

translations.literal: On yimao, Yedu Gao Xingzhou was made Acting Grand Preceptor; Xiang Prefecture An Shenqi Acting Grand Tutor; Yan Prefecture Fu Yanqing Acting Grand Guardian; Northern Capital Liu Chong additionally Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Yedu Gao Xingzhou was made Acting Grand Preceptor, Xiang's An Shenqi Acting Grand Tutor, Yan's Fu Yanqing Acting Grand Guardian, and Northern Capital Liu Chong was additionally made Secretariat Director.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，澶州李洪信移鎮陜州，以侍衛馬軍都指揮使、遂州節度使李洪義為澶州節度使。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Chan Prefecture Li Hongxin was transferred to Shan Prefecture; Imperial Guard cavalry commander and Sui Prefecture military commissioner Li Hongyi was made Chan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Chan's Li Hongxin was transferred to Shan Prefecture, and Imperial Guard cavalry commander and Sui military commissioner Li Hongyi was made Chan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己未，許州劉信加兼侍中，開封尹侯益進封魯國公，鄆州慕容彥超、青州劉銖並加兼侍中。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Xu Prefecture Liu Xin was additionally Palace Attendant; Kaifeng prefect Hou Yi advanced to Duke of Lu; Yun Prefecture Murong Yanchao and Qing Prefecture Liu Zhu were both additionally Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Xu's Liu Xin was additionally made Palace Attendant, Kaifeng prefect Hou Yi was advanced to Duke of Lu, and Yun's Murong Yanchao and Qing's Liu Zhu were both additionally made Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 湖南馬希廣奏，於八月十八日大破朗州馬希萼之眾。

translations.literal: Hunan Ma Xiguang memorialized: on the eighteenth of the eighth month he greatly defeated Lang Prefecture Ma Xie'e's forces.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan's Ma Xiguang reported that on the eighteenth of the eighth month he had inflicted a great defeat on Lang's Ma Xie'e.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，靈州馮暉、夏州李彜殷並加兼中書令。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Ling Prefecture Feng Hui and Xia Prefecture Li Yiyin were both additionally Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Ling's Feng Hui and Xia's Li Yiyin were both additionally made Secretariat Director.

sentences.zh: 右武衛將軍石懿、左武衛將軍石訓並停任。

translations.literal: Right Martial Guard General Shi Yi and Left Martial Guard General Shi Xun were both suspended from office.
translations.idiomatic: Right Martial Guard General Shi Yi and Left Martial Guard General Shi Xun were both suspended from office.

sentences.zh: 懿等以八月中秋，享晉五廟，命倡婦宿於齋宮，鴻臚寺劾之，故有是責。

translations.literal: Yi and the rest, on the Mid-Autumn Festival of the eighth month, offered sacrifice at Jin's five temples and ordered singing girls to lodge in the fasting palace; the Court for Diplomatic Relations impeached them; therefore this punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Yi and the others, at the Mid-Autumn Festival of the eighth month, offered sacrifice at Jin's five temples and ordered singing girls to lodge in the fasting palace. The Court for Diplomatic Relations impeached them, hence this punishment.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，鎮州武行德、鳳翔趙暉並加檢校太師。

translations.literal: On guihai, Zhen Prefecture Wu Xingde and Fengxiang Zhao Hui were both made Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhen's Wu Xingde and Fengxiang's Zhao Hui were both made Acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 鄴都、磁、相、邢、洺等州奏，霖雨害稼。

translations.literal: Yedu, Ci, Xiang, Xing, Ming, and other prefectures reported prolonged rain harming the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Yedu, Ci, Xiang, Xing, Ming, and other prefectures reported that prolonged rain was harming the crops.

sentences.zh: 西京奏，洛水溢岸。

translations.literal: The Western Capital reported the Luo River overflowing its banks.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Capital reported that the Luo River had overflowed its banks.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，晉州王晏、同州張彥赟、邠州侯章、涇州史懿、滄州王景、延州高允權並加檢校太師。

translations.literal: On yichou, Jin Prefecture Wang Yan, Tong Prefecture Zhang Yanyun, Bin Prefecture Hou Zhang, Jing Prefecture Shi Yi, Cang Prefecture Wang Jing, and Yan Prefecture Gao Yunquan were all made Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Jin's Wang Yan, Tong's Zhang Yanyun, Bin's Hou Zhang, Jing's Shi Yi, Cang's Wang Jing, and Yan's Gao Yunquan were all made Acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午朔，契丹入寇。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month on the new moon day gengwu, the Khitan invaded.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month on the new moon (gengwu), the Khitan invaded.

sentences.zh: 是日，定州孫方簡、徐州劉赟並加同平章事，以利州節度使宋延渥為滑州節度使。

translations.literal: That day, Ding Prefecture Sun Fangjian and Xu Prefecture Liu Yun were both made concurrent Councilors of State; Li Prefecture military commissioner Song Yanwo was made Hua military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That day, Ding's Sun Fangjian and Xu's Liu Yun were both made concurrent Councilors of State, and Li military commissioner Song Yanwo was appointed Hua military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，皇弟興元節度使勛加檢校太師。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the emperor's younger brother Xun, Xingyuan military commissioner, was made Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the emperor's younger brother Xun, Xingyuan military commissioner, was made Acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，相州郭謹、貝州王繼宏、邢州薛懷讓並加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Xiang Prefecture Guo Jin, Bei Prefecture Wang Jihong, and Xing Prefecture Xue Huairang were all made Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Xiang's Guo Jin, Bei's Wang Jihong, and Xing's Xue Huairang were all made Acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，安州楊信、鄧州劉重進加檢校太師，河陽李暉加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On gengchen, An Prefecture Yang Xin and Deng Prefecture Liu Chongjin were made Acting Grand Preceptor; Heyang Li Hui was made Acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, An's Yang Xin and Deng's Liu Chongjin were made Acting Grand Preceptor, and Heyang's Li Hui was made Acting Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 壬午，兩浙錢宏俶加守尚書令，湖南馬希廣加守太尉。

translations.literal: On renwu, Liang-Zhe Qian Hongchu was made Acting Director of the Masters of Writing; Hunan Ma Xiguang Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Liang-Zhe's Qian Hongchu was made Acting Director of the Masters of Writing, and Hunan's Ma Xiguang was made Acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 癸未，監修國史蘇逢吉、史官賈緯以所撰《高祖實錄》二十卷上之。

translations.literal: On guiwei, overseer of the compilation of the National History Su Fengji and historiographer Jia Wei presented the twenty juan of the Veritable Records of Gaozu they had compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, overseer of the National History Su Fengji and historiographer Jia Wei presented the twenty-juan Veritable Records of Gaozu they had compiled.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，荊南高保融加檢校太師、兼侍中；

translations.literal: On bingxu, Jingnan Gao Baorong was made Acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Jingnan's Gao Baorong was made Acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 以殿前都部署、江州防禦使李建為遂州節度使，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: made Hall Front commander and Jiang Prefecture defense commissioner Li Jian Sui military commissioner, filling Imperial Guard cavalry commander;
translations.idiomatic: Hall Front commander and Jiang defense commissioner Li Jian was made Sui military commissioner and Imperial Guard cavalry commander;

sentences.zh: 以奉國左廂都指揮使、永州防禦使王殷為夔州節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: made Fengguo Left Wing commander and Yong Prefecture defense commissioner Wang Yin Kui military commissioner, filling Imperial Guard infantry commander.
translations.idiomatic: and Fengguo Left Wing commander and Yong defense commissioner Wang Yin was made Kui military commissioner and Imperial Guard infantry commander.

sentences.zh: 契丹陷貝州高老鎮，南至鄴都北境，又西北至南宮、堂陽，殺掠吏民。

translations.literal: The Khitan captured Bei Prefecture's Gaolao Town, south to Yedu's northern border, and also northwest to Nangong and Tangyang, killing and plundering officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan captured Gaolao Town in Bei Prefecture, advanced south to Yedu's northern border, and also northwest to Nangong and Tangyang, killing and plundering officials and civilians.

sentences.zh: 數州之地，大被其苦，藩郡守將，閉關自固。

translations.literal: Several prefectures' lands greatly suffered their affliction; frontier prefecture defenders closed passes and held themselves secure.
translations.idiomatic: Several prefectures suffered greatly. Frontier defenders closed their passes and held firm.

sentences.zh: 遣樞密使郭威率師巡邊，仍令宣徽使王峻參預軍事。

translations.literal: Sent Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei to lead troops patrolling the border, and also ordered Palace Secretariat commissioner Wang Jun to participate in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Wei to lead troops on a border patrol and ordered Palace Secretariat commissioner Wang Jun to participate in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，府州折從阮進封岐國公，豐州郭勛進封虢國公。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Fu Prefecture Zhe Congruan was advanced to Duke of Qi; Feng Prefecture Guo Xun was advanced to Duke of Guo.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Fu's Zhe Congruan was advanced to Duke of Qi, and Feng's Guo Xun was advanced to Duke of Guo.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，鄜州留後王饒加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on renyin, Fu Prefecture acting commissioner Wang Rao was made Acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renyin, Fu acting commissioner Wang Rao was made Acting Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以吳越國王錢宏俶母吳氏為順德太夫人。

translations.literal: On guichou, made Wuyue King Qian Hongchu's mother Lady Wu Shunde Grand Lady.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Wuyue King Qian Hongchu's mother, Lady Wu, was made Grand Lady of Shunde.

sentences.zh: 時議者曰：「封贈之制，婦人有國邑之號，死乃有謚，后妃公主亦然。

translations.literal: Commentators at the time said: "In the system of enfeoffment and posthumous gifts, women have titles of state fiefs; only after death do they receive posthumous names—empresses, consorts, and princesses are likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators at the time said: "Under the system of enfeoffment and posthumous honors, women receive titles tied to state fiefs and receive posthumous names only after death—empresses, consorts, and princesses follow the same rule.

sentences.zh: 唐則天女主，自我作古，乃生有則天之號，韋庶人有順聖之號，知禮者非之。

translations.literal: Tang's female sovereign Zetian, making antiquity herself, while living bore the title Zetian; Consort Wei bore the title Shunsheng—those who know ritual condemned this.
translations.idiomatic: Tang's Empress Zetian broke precedent by taking the title Zetian in life, and Consort Wei took the title Shunsheng—those versed in ritual condemned this.

sentences.zh: 近代梁氏賜張宗奭妻號曰賢懿，又改為莊惠，今以吳氏為順德，皆非古之道也。

translations.literal: In recent times Liang granted Zhang Zongshuang's wife the title Xianyi, then changed it to Zhuanghui; now making Lady Wu Shunde—all are not the ancient Way."
translations.idiomatic: In recent times Liang granted Zhang Zongshuang's wife the title Worthy and Virtuous, then changed it to Solemn and Gracious; now making Lady Wu Shunde—all depart from ancient practice."

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，以大府卿劉皞為宗正卿。

translations.literal: " On yimao, made Grand Storehouse Director Liu Hao Director of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: " On yimao, Grand Storehouse Director Liu Hao was appointed Director of the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午朔，湖南奏，靜江軍節度使馬希贍以今年十月十八日卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the new moon day gengwu, Hunan memorialized: Jingjiang Army military commissioner Ma Xishan died on the eighteenth of the tenth month of this year.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on the new moon (gengwu), Hunan reported that Jingjiang military commissioner Ma Xishan had died on the eighteenth of the tenth month of this year.

sentences.zh: 廢朝二日。

translations.literal: Court was suspended for two days.
translations.idiomatic: Court was suspended for two days.

sentences.zh: 辛未，日暈三重。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the sun had a triple halo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the sun showed a triple halo.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，司徒、門下侍郎、平章事竇貞固奏，請修晉朝實錄。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Minister of Education, Gate Department Vice Minister, and Councilor Dou Zhengu memorialized, requesting compilation of the Jin dynasty Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Minister of Education, Gate Department Vice Minister, and Councilor Dou Zhengu memorialized requesting compilation of the Jin dynasty Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 詔史官賈緯、竇儼、王伸等修撰。

translations.literal: An edict ordered historiographers Jia Wei, Dou Yan, Wang Shen, and the like to compile them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered historiographers Jia Wei, Dou Yan, Wang Shen, and others to compile them.

sentences.zh: 以禮部尚書張沆復為翰林學士。

translations.literal: Made Minister of Rites Zhang Hong again Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Zhang Hong was again appointed Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 壬午，皇帝二十一姊永寧公主進封秦國長公主。

translations.literal: On renwu, the emperor's twenty-first elder sister, Princess Yongning, was advanced to Grand Princess of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the emperor's twenty-first elder sister, Princess Yongning, was advanced to Grand Princess of Qin.

sentences.zh: 潁州奏，破淮賊於正陽。

translations.literal: Ying Prefecture reported defeating Huai rebels at Zhengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Prefecture reported defeating Huai rebels at Zhengyang.
